notes: Scope: vendor exactly Walmart; 37,151 rows from supplied hammer-products.csv.gz; 128 catalogue items from shared/seed/items.ts. Audit uses names, units and brands only, not price history or live availability. SHA256 compressed CSV 9c1e14ca3df713256eebb22f8b835727d6a07116a6495367d4805429ddf6d1bd

Conservative exclusions include unverifiable rows, not only proven bad products. No size inference from blank units, trays, descriptions, variable-weight packages or marketplace text. Exact catalogue pack size required; the matcher 15% tolerance does not prove shrinkflation. Rounded 1 lb = 454g and supplied 3/10 lb bag conversions retained. No historical-size evidence was supplied.

Catalogue items have no required brand field, so matching generic staple brands are allowed. Organic, flavoured, fortified, premium egg production, dairy-alternative and named incompatible variants are not treated as the baseline staple. Fat percentage is only constrained where catalogue names/aliases constrain it. Generic plant milk allows original/unsweetened, not vanilla. Milk lactose-free catalogue does not specify fat percentage.

Produce sold in singles/bunches and explicit count packs are validated from names. Per-kg catalogue entries require a per-kg/per-lb sales basis; a package weight or variable weight range is not a unit price. Missing price file prevents proving or normalizing these sales units.

Assignments contain only CSV IDs and real item IDs, checked with matchProduct using title=product_name, brand=brand, sizeText=units, price=0, previousSizes=[]. They do not bypass strict matching. All exclusions target products accepted by the supplied matcher, to prevent known or unverifiable false positives. Unmatched products outside the candidate set are left alone.

Strict matcher blocks real 2% partly skimmed milk because skim is tested as a substring of skimmed. Such rows can be wrongly selected as skim; they are excluded here rather than forcing a forbidden assignment. Other false negatives: mass size takes precedence over count, pack of N is not parsed, and global variant words reject medium roast coffee, red kidney beans, extra-soft buns, wheat provenance and whole-wheat all-purpose flour.

Raw per-product price observations are unavailable. data/prices.json and data/hammer-points.json do not provide dependable product-level join provenance for auditing which historical prices already landed. This file does not delete existing price points; the parent must reimport/rebuild after matcher changes.

Coverage: 401 accepted product IDs across 88 catalogue items; 3927 excluded candidate IDs; 80 metadata-good strict-blocked product/item pairs listed below. Accepted rows were reviewed by catalogue and explicit size; ambiguity is excluded.
